title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: dues-waiver eligibility while the enrollment is open
content:
The Corporate Wellness Partnership permits staff to waive a billed amount against a corporate wellness enrollment only while that enrollment's lifecycle status shows active or suspended. A waiver may not be applied against an enrollment whose lifecycle status shows applied or closed.

Stated as condition and action: where the enrollment's current lifecycle status is active or suspended, a waiver may be applied against its billed balance; where the status instead shows applied or closed, no waiver may be applied.

This eligibility basis governs whether a waiver may be applied at all; the amount that may be waived under any particular kind of waiver, and any further limits on that amount, are each stated in their own separate documents.
